channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Nottingham Forest oo 3-2 ku garaacday Chelsea, Xabi Alonso oo la kulmay guuldarradii saddexaad ee xiriirka ah
item.description: Nottingham Forest ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, garoonka City Ground 3-2 kaga adkaatay Chelsea, iyadoo Morgan Gibbs-White uu dhaliyay 2 gool, Igor Jesus-na mid.

item.title: Venezia 0-0 Bologna: gool Venezia ah oo VAR diiday iyo goolhayeyaal xiddig noqday
item.description: Venezia iyo Bologna ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, garoonka Pier Luigi Penzo ku galay barbaro 0-0 ah kulankii furitaanka wareegga 13-aad ee Serie A, kadib markii gool Venezia ah la buriyay dib-u-eegis VAR ah oo ka badan 5 daqiiqo kadib.

item.title: Brest oo 1-0 ku garaacday Paris FC, kuna dhaqaaqday kaalinta saddexaad ee Ligue 1
item.description: Kooxda Brest ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, 1-0 ku garaacday Paris FC, iyadoo goolhayaheeda Egil Selvik uu badbaadiyay dhowr fursadood oo halis ah.

item.title: Werder Bremen 3-3 Gladbach: Füllkrug oo daqiiqadii ugu dambeysay badbaadiyay Werder
item.description: Werder Bremen ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, garoonkeeda 3-3 kula siman Borussia Mönchengladbach, kadib markii ay ka soo kabatay 1-3, iyadoo Niclas Füllkrug uu goolka bareejinta dhaliyay waqtiga dheeraadka ah.

item.title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. oo la sheegay inuu heshiis hal sano ah la galay Toronto Blue Jays
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka baseball-ka ee Jazz Chisholm Jr. ayaa la sheegay inuu heshiis hal sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 20 milyan oo doollar la galay kooxda Toronto Blue Jays, inkastoo kooxdu aysan weli si rasmi ah u xaqiijin.

item.title: Venezuela oo buriyaysa sharcigii mucaaradka ka mamnuucay inay xilal qabtaan
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka ee Venezuela, Jorge Rodríguez, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la buriyo sharci 2024 la ansixiyay oo shakhsiyaadka mucaaradka ka mamnuucayay inay xilal dowladeed qabtaan.

item.title: Putin oo soo bandhigay markab quusaha nukliyeerka ah oo sida gantaallada Zircon
item.description: Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, si rasmi ah ciidamada badda Ruushka ugu wareejiyay markabka quusaha ee Perm, oo Moscow ay sheegtay inuu yahay kii ugu horreeyay ee lagu rakibo gantaallada hypersonic-ga ah ee Zircon.

item.title: Midowga Afrika oo ansixiyay qorshe wajiyo leh oo lagu yareynayo ciidamada AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya
item.description: Midowga Afrika ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, ansixiyay qorshaha kala-guurka ciidamada howlgalka AUSSOM ee Soomaaliya, kaas oo la sheegay inuu saddex weji ku yareynayo ciidamada.

item.title: Ferland Mendy oo 209 maalmood kadib ku soo laabtay liiska Real Madrid ee kulanka Alavés
item.description: Daafaca Faransiiska ee Real Madrid, Ferland Mendy, ayaa ku jira liiska ciyaartoyda ee kulanka Sabtida ee Deportivo Alavés, ku dhawaad toddobo bilood kadib dhaawac culus, sida uu xaqiijiyay tababare José Mourinho.

item.title: Madaxa gargaarka QM oo ka xumaaday dilka shaqaale gargaar oo lagu dilay Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Madaxa arrimaha bani'aadamnimada ee Qaramada Midoobay, Tom Fletcher, ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November 2026, sheegay inuu ka xumaaday weerar lagu dilay shaqaale gargaar oo ka hawlgalayay gobolka Upper Nile ee Koonfur Suudaan.

item.title: Rennes oo shaqada ka eriday tababare Franck Haise kadib guuldarradii Nijmegen
item.description: Kooxda Stade Rennais ee Faransiiska ayaa kala tagtay tababaraheeda Franck Haise, maalin kadib markii ay 3-1 uga dhacday Nijmegen tartanka Europa League.

item.title: Colston Loveland oo dhaawac jilibka ah la ildaran, Chicago Bears waxay sugaysaa ra'yi caafimaad oo labaad
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Chicago Bears ee booska tight end, Colston Loveland, ayaa toddobaad-toddobaad loo eegi doonaa kadib dhaawac jilibka ah oo soo gaaray kulankii Thanksgiving ee Detroit Lions, iyadoo kooxdu ay sugayso ra'yi caafimaad oo labaad.

item.title: Dani Olmo oo sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay Barcelona maadaama Fermín López uu ganaaxan yahay
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee Barcelona Dani Olmo ayaa sheegay inuu boqolkiiba boqol diyaar u yahay, isagoo fursad u helay inuu bilaabo ciyaaraha Deportivo iyo Atlético Madrid, maadaama Fermín López uu ganaaxan yahay.

item.title: Emery oo ammaanay dabeecadda Garnacho kadib markii looga tagay kulankii Galatasaray
item.description: Tababaraha Aston Villa, Unai Emery, ayaa ammaanay dabeecadda Alejandro Garnacho, balse wuxuu tilmaamay in ciyaartoy kale ay hadda ka horreeyaan, kadib markii laacibka reer Argentina looga tagay kulankii Champions League ee Galatasaray.

item.title: Spain: Pedro Sánchez oo rajo ka qaba guul ka hor doorashada degdegga ah ee Axadda
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Spain Pedro Sánchez ayaa sheegay inuusan qiyaasi karin inuu lumiyo doorashada guud ee degdegga ah ee Axadda, inkastoo ra'yi ururinnadu ay muujinayaan in xisbiyada midigta ay hor marayaan.

item.title: Martha Karua oo ku dhawaaqday inay u tartamayso madaxweynaha Kenya doorashada 2027
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga People's Liberation Party (PLP), Martha Karua, ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay u tartami doonto xilka madaxweynaha Kenya doorashada guud ee 2027.

item.title: Shirkadda diyaaradaha Norse Atlantic oo ku dhawaaqday musalafnimo, joojisayna dhammaan duulimaadyadeeda
item.description: Shirkadda diyaaradaha raqiiska ah ee Norway, Norse Atlantic, ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay codsanayso musalafnimo, waxayna joojisay iibinta tigidhada iyo dhammaan duulimaadyadeeda.

item.title: Kenya: Paul Mackenzie oo lagu helay dilka aan ula kaca ahayn ee 123 ka mid ah xubnihii kooxdiisa
item.description: Maxkamad ku taal Mombasa ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November, wadaadka Paul Mackenzie ku heshay dembiga dil aan ula kac ahayn oo la xiriira dhimashada 123 qof oo waaweyn oo ku dhintay gaajo kaynta Shakahola.

item.title: Tottenham oo ilaa 80 maalmood waayi karta Savinho oo mar kale dhaawacmay
item.description: Tababaraha Tottenham Roberto De Zerbi ayaa xaqiijiyay in Savinho uu seegi doono ciyaaraha ciidaha dhammaadka sanadka, uuna garoonka ka maqnaan karo ilaa 80 maalmood.

item.title: Arsenal oo kala tagtay tababaraha kooxdeeda haweenka Renée Slegers natiijooyin liita kadib
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Arsenal ayaa Jimcihii, 27 November, heshiis labada dhinac ah ku kala tagtay tababaraheeda Renée Slegers, kadib bilow xun oo xilli ciyaareedka ah.

item.title: Marc Márquez oo rikoor garoonka ku dhigay tababarka Valencia, maalintii uu ku dhawaaqay fariisashadiisa
item.description: Marc Márquez ayaa Jimcihii ugu dhaqsiyo badnaa tababarka tartanka Valencia, isagoo dhigay rikoor cusub oo garoonka Ricardo Tormo ah, saacado kadib markii uu shaaciyay inuu ka fariisanayo MotoGP.

item.title: Xiisad culus oo ka taagan Wasaaradda Duulista iyo Hawada: Wasiiru-dowlaha oo lagu eedeeyey inuu qori AK-47 ah ku weeraray xafiiska Wasiirka
item.description: Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada, Abdikariim Abdow Heydar, ayaa lagu eedeeyey inuu qori AK-47 ah la tegay xafiiska Wasiirka Maxamed Faarax Nuux, isla markaana uu isku dayey inuu weerar ku qaado. Eedeymahan weli si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin, waxayna u baahan yihiin baaritaan madax-bannaan.

item.title: Ilia Malinin oo Tokyo ku jabiyay rikoorka adduunka ee barnaamijka gaaban ee qoob-ka-ciyaarka barafka
item.description: Xiddigga Mareykanka ee qoob-ka-ciyaarka barafka Ilia Malinin ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Tokyo ee Japan ku dhigay rikoor cusub oo adduunka ah barnaamijka gaaban, isagoo jabiyay rikoorkii Nathan Chen ee Olombikada Beijing.

item.title: Arsenal iyo Man City: Raya oo dib u bilaabay tababarka, Maresca oo yiri labada kooxood lama isbarbardhigi karo
item.description: Ka hor kulanka Axadda ee Arsenal iyo Manchester City, Mikel Arteta ayaa sheegay in goolhaye David Raya uu tababar ku jiro, halka Enzo Maresca uu ciyaarta ku tilmaamay "afar bilood iyo toddoba sano".

item.title: F1: Kimi Antonelli oo ugu dheereeyay tababarka koowaad ee Qatar, George Russell oo labaad ah
item.description: Horyaalka adduunka Kimi Antonelli ayaa Jimcihii ugu waqtiga fiicnaa tababarka koowaad ee Grand Prix-ga Qatar, isagoo ka horreeyay saaxiibkiisa Mercedes George Russell, kahor tartanka labaad ee ugu dambeeya xilli ciyaareedka.

item.title: Tyson Fury oo caafimaad ahaan loo oggolaaday inuu Anthony Joshua kula dagaallamo Cardiff
item.description: Feedhyahanka Ingiriiska Tyson Fury ayaa loo oggolaaday inuu Anthony Joshua kula dagaallamo Cardiff bisha December, kadib markii baaritaannadiisa caafimaad la dhammaystiray, xaaskiisuna ay dib uga noqotay hadal ay ka sheegtay caafimaadkiisa.

item.title: Maresca: Haaland kuma faraxsana qaabka Manchester City, ma aha go'aanka Premier League
item.description: Tababaraha Manchester City, Enzo Maresca, ayaa sheegay in Erling Haaland uu ka xun yahay natiijooyinka xun ee kooxda, kahor kulanka culus ee ay dhammaadka toddobaadkan kula ciyaarayaan Arsenal garoonka Emirates.

item.title: Manchester United oo hawlgelisay ikhtiyaarka kordhinta heshiiska Bruno Fernandes ilaa 2028
item.description: Manchester United ayaa hawlgelisay qodob ku jiray heshiiska kabtankeeda Bruno Fernandes oo u oggolaanaya inay sanad kale ku darto, taas oo heshiiskiisa ka dhigaysa mid dhammaanaya June 2028.

item.title: UEFA oo baaritaan anshax ka furtay rabshadihii kulamada Marseille-Levski iyo Beşiktaş-Hapoel
item.description: UEFA ayaa Jimcihii cambaareysay rabshadihii ka dhacay laba kulan oo Europa League ah, waxayna baaritaanno anshax ka furtay kulankii Marseille iyo Levski Sofia ee Faransiiska iyo kii Beşiktaş iyo Hapoel Be'er Sheva ee Georgia.

item.title: Jamal Musiala oo mar kale murqaha bowdada ka dhaawacmay, Bayern-na ka maqnaan doona afar ilaa lix toddobaad
item.description: Xiddigga Bayern Munich Jamal Musiala ayaa mar kale dillaac murqo ah ka helay bowdada, waxaana la filayaa inuu garoonka ka maqnaado afar ilaa lix toddobaad, taas oo macnaheedu noqon karto inuusan dib u ciyaarin sannadka 2026.
